message.content: No, there is no record of Li Hua sending a message to Wolfgang Schulz preparing all the delicious food for tonight's Chinese Lunar New Year before Wolfgang wished him a happy Lunar New Year. In fact, Wolfgang Schulz mentioned looking forward to enjoying some good food and relaxing, indicating that he had not yet received the preparation update from Li Hua. This interaction appears to have occurred separately from the Lunar New Year preparations.
